query: INSERT INTO sso_group_settings (org_id, claim, scopes, mode) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (org_id) DO UPDATE SET claim = EXCLUDED.claim, scopes = EXCLUDED.scopes, mode = EXCLUDED.mode, claim_missing_at = CASE WHEN sso_group_settings.claim = EXCLUDED.claim THEN sso_group_settings.claim_missing_at END, updated_at = now()
